svg.title: Formats and I/O
svg.desc: A compact format hub separates container detection, the editable model, and explicit export.

text.tspan: Format quirks stay at the boundary.

g.title: Content detection precedes parsing
g.desc: Bytes and container structure select the parser; a filename extension is only a hint.

g.title: Every parser converges on one editable model
g.desc: Blocks, entities, metadata, regions, and bounds use the same in-memory schematic contract.

g.title: Export is an explicit destination choice
g.desc: Structure, snapshot, and world formats keep their own capabilities and loss boundaries visible.

text.tspan: Many containers, one model, explicit destinations
Nucleation isolates format quirks at the edge so edits and analysis operate on one schematic representation.
